name: FrontierISP
summary: Adelaide dialup/hosting ISP (Frontier ISP Pty Ltd, 2001, ACN 092 881 680); evolved into / absorbed by Ai Tel Pty Ltd (same 1800 number).

events.details: Evolved into / absorbed by Ai Tel. Frontier ISP rebranded to Ai Tel between Feb and Aug 2007 and the operation continued (company still registered) — c.2006 was marginally early, 'by 2009' described the Ai Tel page's redirect.

refs.label: by 29 Aug 2007 the site was rebranded 'Ai Tel' (Adelaide) — same services, new name; brand change, not site death
company never deregistered; Ai Tel login/services shell still on the domain in Dec 2021 (webmail-only phase by then)
ABR: FRONTIER ISP PTY LTD ACN 092 881 680
